diffs.diff: minimum supply: part 4.5 V, datasheet reading 5 V
diffs.evidence: Allegro A3141-2-3-4 datasheet, Electrical Characteristics: 'Supply Voltage VCC Operating 4.5 — 24 V'. The exact product's vendor datasheet (Joy-IT SEN-KY003HMS, 2023-08-25) MAIN FEATURES: 'Supply voltage 4,5 - 24 V'. The second reading's 5 V comes from the Joy-IT sensorkit web page, which gives a single recommended 'Operating voltage 5V (Due to the LED)', a nominal operating point rather than the minimum; the model already tells users to power it from 5 V.

diffs.diff: maximum supply: part 24 V, datasheet reading 5 V
diffs.evidence: Allegro A3141-2-3-4 datasheet: operating 'Supply Voltage VCC ... 4.5 — 24 V' (absolute maximum 'Supply Voltage, VCC ... 28 V'). The exact product's vendor datasheet (Joy-IT SEN-KY003HMS) states 'Supply voltage 4,5 - 24 V' for the module, including its status LED. The 5 V in the second reading is the sensorkit page's nominal 'Operating voltage 5V (Due to the LED)', not a maximum rating; the model recommends 5 V in its pin description and build notes.
